output.reason: This company collective agreement sets payroll rules that feed the PPh 21 computation for permanent employees. PPh 21 is borne by the employee, so there is no gross-up. Employer-paid JKK (0.24% garment, 0.89% textile) and JKM (0.30%) enter gross income. Employee-paid JHT (2%) and JP (1%) are deductible. It also defines wage components, the THR, the attendance premium and severance for PKWTT staff.
